items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: We are filming for Hamilton College and developing a jazz archive with America’s greatest jazz musicians. We have with us a fabulous artist on clarinet, Kenny Davern.
Tell us a little bit about the concert that you played last night. It had all the things in it that I try to teach my jazz class.
